artifacts.summary: Five-phase plan extending validate-artifact.sh's existing suite-selection-lib candidate list with the repository-under-validation's declared project suite root(s), naming the resolved corpus in every advisory Tier-Justification warning, adding declared/undeclared/declared-but-absent coverage, a consumer-list doc sync, and a redeploy close.

memory_candidates.content: validate-artifact.sh resolves 'the repository under validation' via _cgs_resolve_repo_root: walk up from the ARTIFACT path's own directory looking for .claude-extensions.json, then fall back to _cgs_find_repo_root "$(pwd)". A test fixture written into a bare `mktemp -d` therefore does NOT get a neutral repo root -- the upward walk finds nothing and the pwd fallback silently hands it the real repository's own .claude-extensions.json and every declaration in it. Any plan phase adding declaration-sensitive fixtures for this script must plant the plan file INSIDE its own scratch root (alongside a scratch .claude-extensions.json), not merely plant the scratch root somewhere and validate from outside it; otherwise the fixture tests the host repository's declarations while appearing to test its own.
